messages:
Sam (AE): Hey team — NimbusHealth trial ends this Friday. They asked for a tidy handback checklist so they can close the PoC. Can we confirm the steps for keys, pools, VPC artifacts, and retention?
Priya (SE): +1. Quick ask: do they want us to rotate hosted API keys immediately or just revoke existing test keys?
Marta (Customer): Ideally revoke test keys now. We'll keep audit copies for 90 days. Not under legal hold.
Jason (DevOps): Plan I propose: 1) revoke hosted API keys 2) scale Dedicated pool down to 0 and then delete 3) remove VPC peering & endpoints 4) snapshot then delete any attached disks 5) purge ephemeral logs per retention.
Lina (Security): For revocation, do staged revoke: disable keys, wait 1 hour for clients to surface errors, then hard-delete. Also export access logs and flow logs to secure bucket with restricted ACLs before purge.
Sam (AE): Good. Can you paste exact commands for the runbook so our PM/ops can execute?
Jason (DevOps): Yep. Using our internal CLI: 
```
# revoke hosted API key
redwoodctl keys revoke --key-id rwd_k_abc123 --confirm
# disable first, then delete after 1h
redwoodctl keys disable --key-id rwd_k_abc123
sleep 3600
redwoodctl keys delete --key-id rwd_k_abc123
\n# scale down dedicated pool
redwoodctl pools update --pool-id pool-nimbus-01 --desired-size 0
redwoodctl pools delete --pool-id pool-nimbus-01 --force
\n# teardown private VPC endpoints
redwoodctl vpc disconnect --vpc-id vpc-0nimbus
aws ec2 delete-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0123
```
Priya (SE): Also add: remove any customer-provided SSH keys from bastion, revoke IAM roles created for the PoC, and remove temporary KMS grants.
Lina (Security): Data retention: they requested 90 days for audit. Our default sandbox retention is 30 days. We'll export a sealed archive to their S3 bucket and tag it: `nimbus-poc/audit-archive-2026-03-21.zip` and set lifecycle to expire after 90 days. Command snippet: 
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/nimbus-audit.zip s3://nimbus-audit-retention/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket nimbus-audit-retention --key audit-archive-2026-03-21.zip --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=retention,Value=90d},{Key=owner,Value=nimbus}]'
```
Marta (Customer): Confirmed — we want the sealed archive in our bucket with 90d lifecycle. No legal hold.
Sam (AE): Who's owning the runbook execution and timeline? Can we finish by EOD Friday?
Jason (DevOps): I can drive. ETA: revoke hosted keys + export logs by Thursday EOD; pool teardown + VPC teardown Friday morning. Will update infra-bot with statuses.
infra-bot: [deploy] revoke-keys-job started by Jason at 1912345720
Priya (SE): Quick checklist item — update the PoC ticket with final config they used (model versions, quantization settings, batch sizing) so their compliance team has it.
Lina (Security): After teardown, I'll run a mini-audit: ensure no open inbound rules, no leftover IAM policies granting broad access, and confirm KMS grants removed.
Sam (AE): Perfect. I'll send the handback note to NimbusHealth and confirm their S3 bucket details for the archive. Thanks all :thumbsup:
